title: Monomial on a subset indicator
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $S$ and $U$ be subsets of the coordinate set $ in n$. Evaluating the monomial indexed by $S$ at the point that equals $1$ on $U$ and $0$ outside $U$ gives $1$ if $S\subseteq U$, and $0$ otherwise.
